notes_for_editor: Thin record. tnlandforms gives the county and coordinates. The Forest Lookouts North Carolina index lists the Peletier entry as 'Carteret County - Croatan National Forest'; the story reports only that pairing, not which body manages the tower, since no source read says so. Wikipedia's Peletier article is used only for the community's location. The Croatan National Forest article read does not mention a tower. The NC NHLR cache index does not list Peletier. The tnlandforms code 'nr EA1362' is unexplained by the page, so it is not used. Search budget for this run ran out, so no search-based leads were checked. Fact-check 2026-10-21: removed the unsupported 'state's list' wording, since no source read calls the tnlandforms list a state list; the agency fact is recast as the index pairing.
